skills.name: Moe-P Beam
skills.description: Fires a heart beam. Bad effects on enemies.   *ATK per sec x 250% Area Damage (10 sec) *Enemy Skill Resistance -30% (10 sec) *Enemy Magical DEF -30000 (10 sec)

skills.name: Oh, Moe-P!
skills.description: Gets happy, surrounded by Moe-P goods. Good effects to allies.  *ATK Speed +300% (7 sec) *Hit Rate +30%  (7 sec) *Cancels continuous damage

abilities.name: Group: Crayon Shinchan
abilities.description: Crayon Shinchan Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Enemy Cost Increase
abilities.description: Gives a high chance of increasing the Mineral Cost for one of the opposing team's Rangers when Rangers with this Ability are deployed. This Ability can activate from 10 seconds after the battle starts.
